svg.title: Five resistors and two unknown pressures
svg.desc: The source pressure is96mmHg and sink pressure6mmHg. Unknown nodes A and B are connected by a bridge resistor. Arrows define positive-flow references; they do not impose one-way flow. Five positive resistance values are shown.
